title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT 2+1+2 NE PAZARIN E RI
description_sq:
Ky apartament ndodhet shume prane Pazarit te Ri, ne nje zone mjaft te qete larg zhurmave, dhe te pershtatshme per banim.
Palllati eshte ne ndertim ne faze te avancuar dhe perfundon ne pranvere te vitit 2026. Ai ka rifinitura shume cilesore dhe fasade te ventiluar.
Aparatamenti organizohet ne:
1 ambient te perbashket ndenje dhe ngrenie
2 dhoma gjumi
2 tualete
1 verande
Ekziston mundesia qe ti bashkangjitet edhe nje studio prej 40 m2 qe ndodhet ne te njejtin kat dhe te behet nje apartament 3+1+3.
Zona ne te cilen ndodhet eshte zona me e kerkuar si nga qytetaret e Tiranes por dhe shume e frekuentuar nga turistet e huaj.
Apartamenti mund te jete dhe nje mundesi shume e mire investimi.
Per me shume informacion na kontaktoni.
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1+2 IN NEW BAZAAR
description_en: This apartment is located very close to the New Market, in a quite quiet area away from the noise, and suitable for living. The building is under construction at an advanced stage and will be completed in the spring of 2026. It has high-quality refinishing and ventilated facades. The equipment is organized in: 1 common living and dining area 2 bedrooms 2 bathrooms 1 veranda There is the possibility to attach a studio of 40 m2 located on the same floor and make it a 3+1+3 apartment. The area in which it is located is the most sought-after area by the citizens of Tirana, but also very frequented by foreign tourists. The apartment can be a very good investment opportunity. For more information, contact us.
